rule: plan 90 §90.3.1 with design general/topics/relevant, howdecided, prominent, howto and general/workup/choose; keys = signed EORS peds general (SD_GEN_ALL: labs, ekg, imaging, anatomy, procedures, guidelines, screenings, workup); PAEA Pediatrics EOR Topic List 2026 (scratch/peds-topics-2026.txt); Leader S10 ruling (selection recorded here, general.json written in S12)

labs.why: Labs are needed for ≥3 listed conditions (anemias, coagulation disorders, lead poisoning, diabetes/DKA, renal disease, infections); her Hematology system is largely lab-defined.

items.item: CBC with indices (MCV), reticulocyte count and peripheral smear
items.covers: Anemias (microcytic, macrocytic, normocytic, hemolytic); Thalassemias; Sickle cell disease; Leukemias (her guide: Hematology anemia rows)

items.item: Iron studies (ferritin, TIBC) and lead level
items.covers: Anemias (iron deficiency); Lead poisoning (her guide: Iron Deficiency and Lead Poisoning rows)
Anemias (macrocytic) (her guide: B12 and Folate Deficiency rows)

items.item: Platelet count, PT/INR, aPTT, von Willebrand panel, factor levels
items.covers: Coagulation disorders; Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (her guide: Bleeding Disorders)

items.item: Hemolysis labs and creatinine (LDH, haptoglobin, bilirubin, smear schistocytes)
Glucose, HbA1c, serum ketones, anion gap and venous blood gas

items.covers: Dehydration (her guide: Dehydration note); Pyloric stenosis (hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis); Renal disease
Cystitis; Vesicourethral reflux; Renal disease — glomerulonephritis, nephrotic syndrome

items.item: TSH and free T4; newborn screen
items.covers: Thyroid and parathyroid disorders; Inborn errors of metabolism (PKU, galactosemia); Newborn assessment

items.item: Calcium, phosphate, PTH and vitamin D
items.covers: Thyroid and parathyroid disorders; Vitamin/Nutritional deficiencies (her guide: Hypercalcemia and Vitamin D rows)

items.item: Rapid strep antigen/throat culture and ASO
items.covers: Pharyngitis; Group A streptococcus; Acute rheumatic fever
Meningitis (her guide: Viral and Bacterial Meningitis rows)

items.item: Inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) and CBC in Kawasaki disease
Febrile infant workup: CBC, blood culture, UA/urine culture, CSF
items.covers: Fever in the infant; Fever without a source; Sepsis

ekg.why: Only specific findings are needed (congenital heart disease, Kawasaki, syncope, rheumatic carditis); her peds guide has no arrhythmia section.

items.item: Chamber hypertrophy and axis deviation in congenital heart disease
items.covers: Congenital heart disease — Tetralogy of Fallot (RVH), VSD, ASD, Coarctation of the aorta (her guide: ASD, PDA, Coarctation, ToF, VSD rows)
Acute rheumatic fever / Acute rheumatic carditis (Jones minor criterion; her guide: Acute Rheumatic Fever row)

items.item: QTc, pre-excitation (WPW) and HCM changes in syncope
items.covers: Syncope, neurogenic (her guide: Syncope row); Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (her guide)

items.item: Arrhythmia and ischemic changes in Kawasaki disease

imaging.why: Imaging is needed for ≥3 listed conditions (pyloric stenosis, intussusception, appendicitis, croup/epiglottitis, foreign body, DDH, SCFE, pneumonia, VUR).

items.item: Abdominal ultrasound: pyloric stenosis, intussusception (target sign), appendicitis
Contrast enema and upper GI series

items.covers: Biliary/Duodenal atresia; Volvulus; Foreign body ingestion

items.item: Neck X-ray: steeple sign, thumb sign, retropharyngeal widening
Chest X-ray: pneumonia, foreign body aspiration (air trapping), RDS ground glass
items.covers: Pneumonias; Foreign body aspiration; Respiratory distress syndrome in the newborn; Cystic fibrosis

items.item: Hip ultrasound (under 4–6 months) and pelvic X-ray (frog-leg)
items.covers: Developmental dysplasia of the hip; Slipped capital femoral epiphysis; Avascular necrosis (Legg-Calvé-Perthes)
Vesicourethral reflux; Cystitis (febrile UTI); Neoplasms (Wilms tumor)
Congenital heart disease; Kawasaki disease (coronary aneurysms); Valvular disorders
Traumatic brain injury; Neoplasms of the central nervous system; Chiari malformation
Neoplasia of the musculoskeletal system (her guide: Osteosarcoma, Ewing Sarcoma rows)

anatomy.why: Only specific structures are needed; her peds guide has no anatomy section.

items.item: Tibial tuberosity and patellar tendon insertion
Proximal femoral physis and femoral head blood supply
items.covers: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis; Avascular necrosis

items.item: Middle ear and eustachian tube in children
items.covers: Otitis media; Dysfunction of eustachian tube

procedures.why: At least three listed conditions need procedures (lumbar puncture for Meningitis and Fever in the infant; reduction for Radial head subluxation and Paraphimosis; foreign-body removal; enema for Intussusception), so prominent (review F6). No top tab carries a procedures how-to, so howto is null.

items.item: Lumbar puncture in infants and children

items.covers: Radial head subluxation (her guide: Nursemaid's Elbow row)

items.item: Ear and nasal foreign body removal; cerumen removal
items.covers: Foreign body; Cerumen impaction (her guide: Nasal Foreign Body, Foreign Body in Ear rows)

guidelines.why: Guidelines apply to ≥3 listed conditions; no top tab carries a guidelines how-to, so howto is null.

items.item: Immunization schedule (her own vaccine notes; Other › Vaccine schedules)
items.covers: Immunization guidelines (her guide: Immunization Guidelines note)

items.item: Urinary tract infection in febrile infants and children (AAP)

items.covers: Asthma (her guide: Asthma rows and Management Basics)

screenings.why: Screening applies to ≥3 listed conditions; no top tab carries a screenings how-to, so howto is null.

items.covers: Developmental milestones; Autism spectrum disorder (her guide: Neurology/Developmental age rows)

items.item: Obesity screening and behavioral interventions, children ≥6 — USPSTF B

items.covers: Hearing disorders (her guide: Hearing Impairment note)

items.item: Newborn screening (metabolic, hearing, critical congenital heart disease)
items.covers: Inborn errors of metabolism; Congenital heart disease; Newborn assessment
